High Roller Week 1 King who captured the $10 bounty behind Caleb Williams' 37.26 pt moonshot. But the victory lap is abruptly cut short as Kittle's hamstring and Zay Flowers are already popping up with question marks. Don't look now, but Week 2 is serving a heavy dose of humble pie.

Dowdle fucking sucks

0-1 (LOSS)
🚨 IR: Jordan Mason (Thumb Surgery)

Pedro literally rebranded his franchise name in disgust after scoring a league-worst 92.6 points. Jordan Mason is on IR with a busted thumb, Rico Dowdle did nothing, and Pedro is currently the designated cardio bunny scheduled to walk a 62-minute 5K for a $189 open bar tab.

MyDakMakesHerWaddle

0-1 (LOSS)
🚨 IR: A.J. Brown (High Ankle Sprain)

The most cursed franchise in America. Put up 122.60 points—enough to beat 4 other teams—only to run straight into the #1 scoring juggernaut. To make matters worse, WR1 A.J. Brown went down with a high ankle sprain, prompting an emergency $20 FAAB panic shopping spree.

1-0 (WIN)
⚠️ Q: Ladd McConkey (Hip/Nail)

Put on a masterclass in brutality with a 164.92 point woodchipper beatdown behind King Henry's stiff-arms and a 20-point defensive clinic. Smugness is at an all-time high, though McConkey is already banged up. Currently hoarding $100 FAAB like Smaug.

1-0 (WIN)

Won comfortably by 39 points, but took a massive punch to the gut with Tank Dell tearing up his knee and heading to IR for the year. Already dipped into the FAAB coffer ($8 spent on SF defense and depth), but still walking tall behind Kenneth Walker and CMC.

CULT OF THE LAMB

⚠️ Q: Brian Thomas, Chris Olave, Pineiro

Suffered a gut-wrenching 13.9-point loss. Now half the wide receiver corps and even the kicker are nursing ailments. Burned $14 FAAB desperately patching holes like the crew of the Titanic, but CeeDee Lamb can only carry so many passengers.

Show me dem TDs

1-0 (WIN)

Brock To The Future

1-0 (WIN)
⚠️ Q: Brock Bowers | 🚨 PUP: Charbonnet

The undisputed Schedule Luck Merchant. Scored a modest 127.76 points, but got gifted the easiest matchup on the calendar against Pedro's walking disaster. Bowers is nursing a sore knee and Charbonnet is locked on PUP, but a 1-0 record doesn't ask how.

Draft Order Decider

⚽ 5v5 Indoor Soccer Rules

Official tournament constitution for the 2026 F.F.U.C. Draft Day Tournament.

🔍 Click to View Full-Size Image
10
Tournament Format

90-Minute Marathon • 10 Rounds

A relentless 90-minute 5v5 indoor soccer tournament featuring 10 total rounds. Rotating rosters every match ensure stamina, heart, and adaptability dictate the board.

3/1/0
Scoring System

Pure Team Outcome Points

Points are awarded solely on team outcomes: 3 Points for a Win, 1 Point for a Draw, and 0 Points for a Loss. Individual goals mean nothing without team victory.

⏱️
Match Clock

5-Min Matches + 3-Min Rest

Each round consists of a high-intensity 5-minute match followed by a mandatory 3-minute rest/hydration window before rosters shuffle for the next round.

🎯
Tiebreaker Protocol

Skill Challenges & Shootouts

When points are tied at the conclusion of 10 rounds, draft slot tiebreaks are resolved via skills challenges: dribbling obstacle courses, furthest goal strikes, and penalty kicks ("penatels").

Arnulfo Escamilla: League Server for the Day & The $480.18 Cactus Cove Tab

Tab Settled: $480.18

📜 F.F.U.C. League Constitution

The supreme law of the league. Payout structures, weekly bounties, and punishment rules.

⚖️

ARTICLE I: THE 5K THIRST TRAP PUNISHMENT

Mandatory

1. The franchise finishing in 10th Place at the conclusion of the Toilet Bowl bracket must run or walk an official 3.1-mile 5K route directly to the designated league bar.
2. The 9 non-punished managers assemble at the bar prior to start time.
3. The Open Tab Window: The moment the 10th place runner starts their GPS watch, an open bar tab is opened under the loser's credit card. The tab remains open until the runner physically crosses the bar's doorway.
4. Draft Calibration: Beers are calibrated at $7.00 draft pints under normal drinking etiquette. Slow walking significantly increases financial liability.

ARTICLE II: WEEKLY $10 CASH BOUNTY SCHEDULE

$140 Total Pot

A weekly cash prize of $10 is awarded to the manager whose starting lineup meets the designated weekly challenge:

WK 1: $10 Most Points (Saquon Deez)
WK 2: $10 Highest Scoring QB
WK 3: $10 Highest Scoring RB
WK 4: $10 Highest Scoring WR

ARTICLE III: $45 NFL PICK-EM POOL

$45 Season Prize

All 10 managers compete in the weekly NFL straight-up pick-em tournament (ID: 1402701854898450432). The manager with the highest cumulative regular-season correct picks takes home the full $45 pot at the end of Week 14.
